title: LLM Engineer Path
tagline: From tokens to production agents, in twelve weeks.

stages.name: Foundations
stages.goal: Know what a token, an embedding, an attention block and a fine-tune actually are, with code you have run.

stages.name: Engineering the application
stages.goal: Design, evaluate and iterate on an LLM application: evals first, RAG before fine-tuning, deterministic workflows, and the judgment calls practitioners make.

stages.name: Agents
stages.goal: Build agents three ways, then learn which framework ideas are essential and how to own prompts, context, state and control flow in production.

stages.name: Production
stages.goal: Serve and scale: metrics, GPU sizing, batching, KV cache techniques, speculative decoding and operations.

method.title: Read or watch the source first
method.text: Each lesson names the chapter, unit, factor, page or talk and links straight to it. The lesson page is a study guide to check your understanding, not a replacement.

method.title: Run the notebook
method.text: Where a Colab notebook exists the lesson has an Open in Colab button. Run it top to bottom before changing anything, then follow the walkthrough.

method.title: Do the exercise and write notes
method.text: Every lesson has an exercise sized for 30 to 180 minutes and a notes box. Keep a repo; several later exercises build on earlier ones.

method.title: Flashcards, then the module quiz
method.text: Review the module's flashcards until you rate them easy, then take the quiz. Pass mark is 70%; retakes are unlimited.

method.title: Build the module project
method.text: Each module ends with a project and a rubric. Self-assess against the rubric and record it on the Projects page.

method.title: Final exam and certificate
method.text: After all seven modules, pass the final exam to unlock the certificate.

faq.a: Not for most of the path. Google Colab's free T4 covers the Hands-On LLM notebooks and the Hugging Face course. Fine-tuning exercises in Module 3 and serving experiments in Module 7 are easier with a rented GPU for a few hours.

faq.q: I already know how transformers work. Where do I start?
faq.a: Skim Module 1's lesson summaries, take its quiz to confirm, then start at Module 2.

faq.q: How long does it really take?
faq.a: About 72 hours of reading, notebooks and exercises, plus the module projects if you do them all. Six hours a week makes twelve weeks.
It is a self-issued completion record from this study path, not an accredited credential. The Hugging Face Agents Course in Module 5 issues its own free certificate.
